visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts with a high-angle shot looking out of an airplane window. A white airplane wing with a red circle logo is prominent on the left, extending over a vast expanse of white, fluffy clouds under a bright blue sky. In the distance, the iconic snow-covered peak of Mount Fuji emerges from the cloud layer. Pink text is centered. (2) The view shifts to a static window framing the sky, showing a textured sea of clouds stretching to the horizon under a soft, diffused natural light. More pink text appears at the bottom of the frame. (3) A close-up shot of an in-flight meal tray from Japan Airlines (JAL) inside a plane cabin. The tray is set on a gray folding table in front of a seatback screen displaying a video. The meal includes a main dish with yellow omelet or rice, a fresh green salad, a small red appetizer, and a cup of Häagen-Dazs vanilla ice cream alongside orange juice. (4) A transition shows the exterior of a white STARLUX aircraft parked on a gray airport tarmac under an overcast sky. Ground service vehicles, including two small black tugs, are parked near the plane's nose, and a passenger boarding bridge is connected to the side. (5) The camera captures a close-up of a STARLUX airplane meal tray. It features a bowl of Yakiniku-style beef over rice with a piece of broccoli and red ginger, accompanied by a small bowl of fruit, a side dish with black fungus, and a cup of orange juice. (6) A wide shot shows an All Nippon Airways (ANA) aircraft on a taxiway. The plane is white with blue stripes on its tail. The background features airport infrastructure and a clear sky with a distant plane taking off or landing. (7) Detailed close-up of an ANA meal tray. The main course is rice topped with a red sauce and a large mushroom, served with steamed broccoli. Side dishes include a ham and cashew nut salad, a fruit cup with melon and pineapple, and a packet of snack mix. (8) The shot transitions to a China Airlines meal. The tray holds a bowl of rice mixed with eggs and meat, garnished with red ginger. A small square cake with pink and white layers, a bowl of duck breast salad, a bread roll, and a cup of hot tea are also visible. (9) A low-angle exterior shot of an EVA Air plane, white with green lettering, parked at an airport terminal. A white baggage loader is positioned near the front of the aircraft. (10) A close-up focus on an EVA Air pasta dish with bright red tomato sauce and several large pink shrimp. In the background, two small side bowls containing fruit and a creamy salad are visible on the tray. (11) The camera shows a Cathay Pacific airplane parked at a gate, surrounded by airport service equipment under a hazy sky. (12) The final meal review features a Cathay Pacific tray containing curry meat with white rice and broccoli, a side of cold buckwheat noodles with a crab stick, a cup of orange juice, and another cup of vanilla Häagen-Dazs ice cream. (13) The video ends with a bright pink screen featuring the 'Japanuts' logo—a pink circle with a cherry blossom and text. Icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube are listed below with social media handles, followed by a call to action to like, comment, and share.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋 ジャパンナッツ. [Subtitle]: 你們搭飛機最期待什麼？ (2) [Subtitle]: 除了景色我也注意飛機餐，來分享我的飛機餐評比. (3) [Slogan]: 日本航空. [Subtitle]: 日航是我心中第一名，除了餐好吃，冰淇淋也加分. (4) [Slogan]: 星宇航空. [Subtitle]: 星宇是我的第二名，燒肉飯好吃，但從其他機場飛回台灣的餐，就味道差滿多的. (5) [Subtitle]: 不過星宇的大螢幕真的很讚. (6) [Slogan]: 全日空. [Subtitle]: 全日空我給第三名，因為出餐內容很不一致. (7) [Subtitle]: 前幾天剛好又搭，我的餐沒有麵包，但朋友的有，搞不清楚是還有還沒有. (8) [Slogan]: 中華航空. [Subtitle]: 華航的餐點，有吃過三杯雞還不錯，但其他都沒有記憶點. (9) [Slogan]: 長榮航空. [Subtitle]: 長榮的我覺得之前不錯，但近期越來越不太對胃. (10) [Slogan]: 國泰航空. [Subtitle]: 抱歉了國泰航空，你們的餐我真的不愛. (11) [Subtitle]: 但有哈根達斯冰淇淋，還是有加分一些的. (12) [Slogan]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結. [Logo]: japanuts.com.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a subjective ranking and review of in-flight meals from several major airlines (JAL, STARLUX, ANA, China Airlines, EVA Air, Cathay Pacific). It aims to share the creator's personal travel experiences and preferences with their audience, using the food quality and specific catering highlights (like ice cream) as the primary appeal.
